description: API developers need to reproduce how a webhook provider canonicalizes headers and payloads when a signature mismatch occurs.

body_text.description: Accept the exact request body as plain text. Preserve all characters exactly as entered, including line breaks and trailing whitespace, before applying the selected signing rule mode. If empty, the body is treated as an empty string, not missing.

headers_text.description: Accept raw HTTP header lines in plain text. Each non-empty line should be in the form Name: value. Leading and trailing whitespace around names and values is trimmed during parsing. Duplicate header names are allowed and are preserved in input order for canonicalization. If empty, the tool must return an input error state.

secret_or_shared_key.description: Accept the webhook signing secret or shared key as text. The tool must not mask, store, transmit, or auto-save it. Empty input is invalid.

signing_rule_mode.description: Select one deterministic signing rule mode. The tool must apply the chosen rule exactly and must not infer undocumented provider-specific behavior outside the selected mode.

timestamp_tolerance.description: Enter a non-negative whole number of seconds. Used only when the selected signing rule mode requires timestamp verification. Values above 86400 are invalid. A tolerance of 0 means only exact timestamp matches are considered valid.

name: webhook-signature-canonicalization-inspector
title: Webhook Signature Canonicalization Inspector
